terminal_clerk.text: Bore da! Holyhead sits on Holy Island, Ynys Gybi, joined to Anglesey by a causeway and a very long habit.
The ferries run from here to Dublin, Baile Átha Cliath. A bit over three hours, and the tea is better than you'd fear.
Our breakwater is one of the longest in Britain, over a mile and a half of stone. The Victorians built it for ships.

holyhead_bureau.text: Bureau de change! Off to Dublin? They use the euro over there, so you'll want some.
Belfast's still sterling, mind. It's only the Republic that's euros. Confusing? Welcome to the Irish Sea.
